name: ExpPricePosition
summary: This Expert Advisor trades based on a multi-indicator confluence system combining PricePosition and StepUpDown indicators across multiple timeframes. It uses SMMA/SMA moving average crossovers and price position relative to signal lines to generate buy/sell signals, with dynamic lot sizing, trailing stops, and opposite-signal closing capabilities.
summary_zh: 该EA基于PricePosition和StepUpDown指标的多指标共振系统进行交易，结合多个时间周期的SMMA/SMA均线交叉和价格相对于信号线的位置来产生买卖信号，具备动态仓位、追踪止损和反向信号平仓功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于PricePosition指标判断价格方向和StepUpDown指标判断趋势走向的双重确认机制。入场条件要求多个条件共振：PricePosition方向(1或-1)、StepUpDown趋势方向一致、当前K线为阳线(买入)或阴线(卖出)、价格回踩至快速SMMA均线附近、快速均线方向确认、以及多周期动量比较(pwr0>pwr1)。出场条件包括：追踪止损触发、反向信号平仓(CloseByOppositeSignal)、以及StepUpDown方向反转时盈利平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数和动态手数两种模式，动态模式根据账户余额和风险百分比计算手数，并按持仓数量均分。资金管理方面，止损基于风险百分比和tick价值计算，止盈为止损的TPvsSLRatio倍，默认3倍，同时设有38pip的最小止损距离保护。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual-confirmation mechanism using the PricePosition indicator for price direction and the StepUpDown indicator for trend direction. Entry conditions require multiple confluences: PricePosition direction alignment (1 or -1), StepUpDown trend agreement, current candle being bullish (for buy) or bearish (for sell), price pulling back to the fast SMMA line, fast MA direction confirmation, and multi-timeframe momentum comparison (pwr0 > pwr1). Exit conditions include: trailing stop activation, closing on opposite signal (CloseByOppositeSignal), and profitable closing when StepUpDown direction reverses. Position sizing supports both fixed lot and dynamic lot modes, where the dynamic mode calculates lot size based on account balance and risk percentage, distributed across open positions. Money management calculates stop loss based on risk percentage and tick value, with take profit set as a multiple (TPvsSLRatio, default 3x) of the stop loss, and a minimum 38-pip stop loss distance as protection.

pros: 多指标多周期共振入场，过滤假信号能力强，入场条件严格
支持动态仓位计算，根据账户余额和风险百分比自动调整手数，风险可控
具备追踪止损和反向信号平仓双重出场机制，盈利保护充分
pros_en: Multi-indicator multi-timeframe confluence entry provides strong false signal filtering with strict entry conditions
Supports dynamic position sizing based on account balance and risk percentage, keeping risk controlled
Dual exit mechanism with trailing stop and opposite signal closing provides solid profit protection
cons: 内存泄漏严重：OnTimer中每次new创建CTrade等对象但从未delete，每分钟都会泄漏
OnTimer中使用定时器而非OnTick驱动交易，可能错过快速行情中的交易机会
信号逻辑中pwr计算使用日线收盘价与小时线收盘价比较，但没有考虑跨品种或跳空情况
CheckOpenPosition中先调用PositionSelect再遍历PositionsTotal，逻辑可能不一致
cons_en: Severe memory leak: CTrade, CSymbolInfo, CPositionInfo, CAccountInfo objects are created with 'new' in OnTimer every minute but never deleted
Uses timer-driven trading (OnTimer) instead of tick-driven (OnTick), potentially missing fast market opportunities
The pwr calculation compares daily close with hourly close but doesn't account for gaps or cross-session discontinuities
CheckOpenPosition calls PositionSelect before iterating PositionsTotal, which may cause logical inconsistency
improvements: 修复内存泄漏：将CTrade等对象移至OnInit中创建，或使用delete释放；最好改为全局对象一次初始化
将交易逻辑从OnTimer迁移至OnTick，增加新K线检测逻辑，确保及时响应行情变化
增加点差过滤器，避免在高点差时段开仓；增加最大持仓数限制防止单品种过度集中
improvements_en: Fix memory leak: move CTrade and other object creation to OnInit or add proper delete calls; best to use global objects initialized once
Migrate trading logic from OnTimer to OnTick with new bar detection to ensure timely response to market changes
Add spread filter to avoid opening positions during high spread periods; add maximum position limit to prevent over-concentration on a single symbol

risk_points: 内存泄漏可能导致长时间运行后EA崩溃或平台卡顿
定时器驱动交易(每分钟检查一次)在高频波动市场中反应迟缓，可能导致滑点增大
追踪止损值默认仅10点，在波动较大的品种上可能过于紧密导致过早止损
CalculatePips中止损最小值38pip的硬编码对不同品种可能不适合
risk_points_en: Memory leak may cause EA crash or platform slowdown during extended runtime
Timer-driven trading (checking every minute) is slow to respond in volatile markets, potentially increasing slippage
Default trailing stop of only 10 pips may be too tight for volatile instruments, causing premature stops
Hardcoded minimum 38-pip stop loss in CalculatePips may not suit all trading instruments
